guide.title: User Guide
guide.subtitle: Everything you need to know to get the perfect document on the first try
guide.step_1_desc: Prompt mode — just describe the document in your own words. Form — fill in the form with exact parameters: discipline, hours, group, semester.
guide.step_1_tip: We recommend prompt mode for first-timers
guide.step_2_desc: RUP (Working Curriculum / Syllabus) — full discipline program. Course Plan (KTP) — weekly schedule with topics.
guide.step_3_title: Write a request or fill out the form
guide.step_3_desc: In quick mode — type a description in the prompt field. In detailed mode — fill in all form fields. The more detail, the better the result.
guide.step_4_desc: After 1–3 minutes the finished .docx file will download automatically. The document is print-ready and meets department templates.
guide.step_4_tip: All documents are saved in your profile history
guide.faq_1_a: Usually 1–3 minutes, depending on document complexity and server load.
guide.faq_2_a: Yes, the document downloads as .docx and opens in Microsoft Word or Google Docs.
guide.faq_3_a: 10 generations per day. The counter resets at 00:00 Astana time.
guide.faq_4_a: RUP, Syllabus, KTP, lecture/lab/practical methodologies, SRO, SROP, midterm and final control.
guide.faq_5_q: Do I need to upload a syllabus?
guide.faq_5_a: No, you can enter data manually. Uploading a syllabus speeds up the process and improves quality.
guide.faq_6_q: What languages does the platform support?
guide.faq_6_a: The interface and documents are available in Russian, Kazakh and English.
